cinematic_dialogue:1:1660303001:.text: Are these the things it summoned?
cinematic_dialogue:1:1660303001:.source_cn: 这些怪物都是被召唤来的吗？

cinematic_dialogue:1:1660303002:.text: And if we trigger it again, we might get something even worse.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1660303002:.source_cn: 嗯，或许下次会有更强大的怪物前来
cinematic_dialogue:1:1660303002:.male: And if we trigger it again, we might get something even worse.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1660303002:.female: And if we trigger it again, we might get something even worse.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1660303003:.text: Yeah, that could go really, really wrong...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1660303004:.text: We need supplies. Anything that might give us an edge!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1660303004:.source_cn: 我们得多找点有用的道具才行！
